Class AdocUnion

java.lang.Object
network.ike.plugin.adoc.AdocUnion
public final class AdocUnion extends Object
One union of AsciiDoc packages per repository, written and verified from any module of it. The union mirrors every declared library's root: a package such as network.ike.lab/dev is copied from an external library's zip, or linked to a reactor member's src/docs/asciidoc/network.ike.lab/dev so an edit reached through an include changes the real source. Each library's manifest and a stamp are under META-INF/ike/<group>/<artifact>/, which is how a later run knows what is there.

The rules, in the order they are applied:

  • A zip without a manifest is a legacy library. With legacy mode on it is unpacked into the legacy per-module directory as the stock unpack did; otherwise the build refuses, naming the artifact.
  • Two libraries that ship one package are refused, naming both. A library already in the union that no module declares anymore counts too, since the union is one per repository.
  • An unchanged library is not rewritten: a copy is keyed by the zip's SHA-256, a link by its target.
  • A stale entry whose library is not among those declared is left alone; a run writes only the libraries it was given.

Whether IntelliJ resolves includes, previews and navigates through a symbolic link in target/generated-sources is to be confirmed by KEC on one machine; until then the link stays the default and link=false copies a member's tree instead.

    • verifyIncludes

      public int verifyIncludes(Path sourceDirectory, Path localRepository)
      Checks that every {adoc} and {topics} include under a module's own AsciiDoc source root resolves in the union. An include into the legacy directory through {topics} also resolves while a legacy library was unpacked there. An unresolved include fails the build with the library that ships the package and the exact dependency block to add, found in the union's manifests, then in the local repository; nothing is fetched.
      Parameters:
      sourceDirectory - the module's src/docs/asciidoc
      localRepository - the local repository root, searched for the suggestion
      Returns:
      the number of includes that resolved
      Throws:
      org.apache.maven.api.plugin.MojoException - when an include does not resolve
